column1: # Xian: Feizhi's warning, Feh's school, Force and Chi, Hsu's disappearance and the blocked Silk Road.

column3: Master Feh is speaking\nwith Feizhi.{page_break}Please don't interrupt.{end_wait}
You carry weapons.\nDoes our training\nseem useless to you?{end_wait}
My feet hurt after\nevery lesson.{page_break}Still, I'll return\ntomorrow.{end_wait}
That was a good punch.\nYou caught me off guard.{end_wait}
A blade means little\nif you cannot land\na single blow.{end_wait}
Warriors travel here\nto learn from Feh.{page_break}His school has earned\nits reputation.{end_wait}
Kick from the hip.\nKeep your weight steady.\nNow try again.{end_wait}
You came to study?{page_break}Master Feh rarely\naccepts strangers.{end_wait}
Feizhi and her father\nare arguing again.{page_break}Please leave them\nin peace.{end_wait}
The tree fell!\nNo one even touched it!{end_wait}
Don't push the tree.\nStrike it with Chi\nfrom the marked line.{end_wait}
What did you do\nto that tree?{end_wait}
He struck the tree\nwithout touching it!{page_break}Master Feh must\nsee this.{end_wait}
Your Chi reached\nacross the yard.{page_break}I'll tell Master Feh.{end_wait}
He has no training\nin our school.{page_break}How could he use Chi?{end_wait}
The door opened\nwithout a hand\non the latch!{end_wait}
Are you worried\nabout Hsu?{end_wait}
He's only late\nreturning from Lama\nTemple. Give him time.{end_wait}
No. Something is wrong.\nI can feel it.{end_wait}
Feizhi... Is this\nanother of your visions?{end_wait}
Ever since the stones\nstruck me, I have seen\nthings before they happen.{end_wait}
I don't doubt you\nare afraid, Feizhi.{page_break}But fear can make\ncoincidence seem certain.{end_wait}
How many visions\nmust come true before\nyou believe me?{end_wait}
I dreamed the forest\nwould swallow the road.{page_break}Then travelers\nstopped coming.{end_wait}
You warned us\nabout the forest.{page_break}I still don't know\nhow you knew.{end_wait}
I warned you\nabout the falling rocks.\nWas that chance too?{end_wait}
Feizhi has been right\ntoo many times\nfor me to dismiss it.{end_wait}
I remember every\nprediction.{page_break}That does not prove\nwhat caused them.{end_wait}
You still refuse\nto believe me?{end_wait}
Hsu is late.\nThat alone does not\nmean he is hurt.{end_wait}
Did you send anyone\nto search for Hsu?{end_wait}
Feizhi! You will not\nspeak to your father\nin that manner.{end_wait}
Then I'll go myself.\nI won't wait here\nwhile Hsu is in danger.{end_wait}
Master Feh!\nFeizhi has left\nthe school!{end_wait}
I've never seen her\nso angry.{page_break}She looked terrified.{end_wait}
She believes Hsu\nis in danger.{page_break}She's gone to find him.{end_wait}
Feizhi can defend\nherself.{page_break}I hope that will\nbe enough.{end_wait}
She's traveling alone.\nThe roads aren't safe.{end_wait}
She'll come back\nwhen she calms down.{page_break}At least, I hope so.{end_wait}
That tree fell\nwithout a touch.{end_wait}
The traveler used\nsome kind of power.{end_wait}
Show me again.\nStand at the line\nand strike the tree.{end_wait}
Show us your Chi\nfrom the marked line.{end_wait}
I want to see\nthat power again.{end_wait}
Warrior, show me\nyour Chi.{end_wait}
Feizhi left alone.\nThe road is dangerous.\nI'm worried for her.{end_wait}
Feizhi trains harder\nthan anyone here.{page_break}She may be safer\nthan we think.{end_wait}
Use Chi again,\njust as before.{end_wait}
Impressive, warrior.{page_break}Master Feh can do\nmore than that.{end_wait}
Please show me\nyour Chi again.{end_wait}
My fists are strong,\nbut I must learn\nto control them.{end_wait}
Show us that power.\nI want to understand\nhow it works.{end_wait}
He has no training\nwith Master Feh.{page_break}How can he use\nthat technique?{end_wait}
Feizhi is alone\non the western road.{page_break}Someone should\ngo after her.{end_wait}
Feizhi is strong.\nI pray she returns\nwith Hsu.{end_wait}
You learned that\npower at Fuchin,\ndidn't you?{end_wait}
Why hide your power?\nMaster Feh only wants\nto understand it.{end_wait}
I wish I could\nmove a tree from\nacross the yard.{end_wait}
I can strike hard.\nNow I must learn\nwhen not to.{end_wait}
Show me your Chi\nfrom the line.{end_wait}
Please don't hide\nyour power from Feh.{page_break}I told him\nwhat I saw.{end_wait}
Master, did you see?\nHe moved the tree!{end_wait}
Master? What's wrong?{end_wait}
He wasn't standing\nat the line.{page_break}I cannot judge\nwhat I saw.{end_wait}
Stand at the line.\nTry it again.{end_wait}
Use your Chi\nfrom the line.{end_wait}
Please stand\nat the marked line\nand try again.{end_wait}
The rules are clear.\nYou must stand\nbehind the line.{end_wait}
Almost! Stand\nat the line\nand try once more.{end_wait}
Master, the traveler\nmoved the tree!{end_wait}
His power is strong.\nDid you see it?{end_wait}
The tree fell.\nThat much is certain.{end_wait}
Is something wrong\nwith his technique?{end_wait}
What he used\nwas not Chi.{end_wait}
It resembles Chi,\nbut its source\nis different.{end_wait}
What does Fuchin\nhave to do with Chi?{end_wait}
Master Hama taught me\nChi at Lama Temple.{end_wait}
Then aren't they\nthe same power?{end_wait}
They may look alike.\nThat does not make\nthem the same.{end_wait}
Chi gathers energy\nwithin the body.{page_break}We release it\nthrough the hands.{end_wait}
Your power comes\nfrom the mind.\nDo you understand?{end_now}
To move the tree\nwith thought alone\nrequires discipline.{end_wait}
Remember this:{page_break}A thought becomes\npower through focus.{end_wait}
Fuchin's Ki and Chi\nare different paths\nto hidden strength.{end_wait}
The body tires.\nThe mind has limits\nof its own.{end_wait}
Train that power\nwith care, warrior.\nIt may save you.{end_wait}
Practice your Chi.\nStrength without\ncontrol is wasted.{end_wait}
You've earned\nmy respect, warrior.{end_wait}
I want to learn\nMaster Feh's Chi.{page_break}I'll train until\nI understand it.{end_wait}
Gather the energy\nin your hands.{page_break}Release it with\ncontrol, not anger.{end_wait}

Lama Temple lies
west of Altin,
near Lamakan Desert.{page_break}Hsu went there
to study.{end_wait}
I misjudged you.\nPlease forgive me.{end_wait}
Where has Feizhi gone?\nI'm worried for her.{end_wait}
Hsu is late.{page_break}I understand why\nFeizhi is afraid.{end_wait}
One day I'll master\nChi as well as Feh.{page_break}Perhaps even better.{end_wait}
Your power comes\nfrom Fuchin Temple?{page_break}How is it different\nfrom our Chi?{end_wait}
Chi or Ki...\nI want to learn\nwhat you can do.{end_wait}
They say Master Hama\ncan break stone\nwith Chi.{page_break}Could Hsu do that?{end_wait}
Follow the road\nwest toward Altin.{page_break}Lama Temple lies\nbeyond the mountains.{end_wait}
You fight with weapons\nand use Ki as well.{page_break}I hope you know\nwhen to stop.{end_wait}
Feizhi has gone.\nThe school feels\nempty without her.{end_wait}
Feizhi worries\nonly about Hsu.{page_break}I wish she'd\nnotice me too.{end_wait}
Learning Chi is hard.\nFeh makes it look\nso simple.{end_wait}
Can someone so young\nreally wield that power?{end_wait}
You are skilled.\nI'll train harder\nfrom now on.{end_wait}
That isn't Chi...\nWait. What was\nthat power?{end_wait}
Stay behind the line.\nThose are the rules.{end_wait}
Stand beyond the line.\nThen use your power.{end_wait}
Silk Road is blocked!\nThe rocks have buried\nthe passage!{end_wait}
My vision came true.\nI knew something\nwas wrong.{end_wait}
I can't hear Hsu.\nNot even a whisper.{end_wait}
I won't turn back.\nHsu is still\nout there.{end_wait}
You're right.\nI have to find Hsu.{end_wait}
Hsu is in danger.\nI can feel it.{page_break}I must find him\nbefore it's too late.{end_wait}
